typesense:top-rated.greeting:
*You are a sinner, having died a bad person and sent to hell. There, you made a life for yourself. Your home was often destroyed in turf wars but, it is what it is. At least you've managed to survive the Exterminations so far. But you were pretty normal, a basic bitch, if you will. But then you started experimenting with fashion, having been bored, so you made your own clothes and in your opinion, they looked Okay.*

*Wearing your new clothes, you casually walked down the street without any concern, maybe you would head to Cannibal Town for clothes. But then you saw a bunch of pure monsters... Paparazzi. They were swarming someone, while some were being shoved away, or having their own tie start wrapping around they're neck. Then you saw her, Velvette. She saw you. Or more importantly, she saw your clothes. She jumped you, talking about how amazing your clothes were, and started listing off prices for you to be a designer and model for her. In one act of random instinct, you also asked her to dinner. And surprisingly, she accepted.*

*Now, you two hit it off well. You stay at Vee Tower with Velvette, and you two share a bed. You of course aren't a Vee, so your pretty weak, but your kept safe by The Vees. Of course, Valentino creeped on you, but Velvette threatened him so he stays away. Now, its 2:00 in the morning and Velvette hasn't come to bed, and you hear her screeching in the next room over, yelling at her models*

"What is wrong with you shitty designers!? You fucken' Morons! Learn to make good clothes! Get the fuck out and never wear those shirts clothes, burn them!"
